dialogue_text: Chapter 1. CODENAME J and BAEG-YA
Pizza delivery.
Long time no see, Codename J. I missed this taste.
I missed this taste. Your taste is still as strange as your personality. I ordered a large. Where’s the cola? Prices in Korea must be getting rough these days. How did you find me?
How did you find me?
You made an interesting friend. Hana has nothing to do with this. She must mean a lot to you.
She must mean a lot to you. You’ve had your fun. Come back to BAEG-YA. I’m never going back to BAEG-YA.
Where did you say this Hana girl lives? Help me for six months.
Help me for six months. And Hana stays untouched. Yeah, Hana. Jaei, where are you?
Jaei, where are you? Chapter 2. Jaei & Hana 6 years ago
Wait, what are you doing? I have cram school.
I have cram school. Hey. You told the teacher, didn’t you? That’s because... You were picking on people first. Bad grades, playing hero? Come with us for a second.
Hey! You got us in trouble. Then... maybe stop picking on people. You clueless little loser!
You clueless little loser! Ah! Stop it! Don’t do this!
Hey, who the hell are you?
Hey. You can stand up by yourself, right?
Hey. You can stand up by yourself, right? Um... wait... Thank you~
So Cha Yura still sends her favorite blade. None of your business. Codename J. Let’s see if the rumor is true.
Let’s see if the rumor is true. You’re fast. Not enough.
Tell Cha Yura...
Tell Cha Yura... She still owes me. No message. Papa...?
Huh? That person from before...! Wait!
Wait!
Hi. Do you remember me? No. You saved me back then.
I don't remember. Still, I wanted to thank you. Don't need it. Get lost.
I'm Seol Hana. I didn't ask. I just wanted to tell you. Can you tell me your name too?
Can you tell me your name too? Hi! I told you not to acknowledge me.
Delivering again today? Isn't it obvious?
I bought this for you. I'm not drinking it. Can't you just take it? You really don't listen, do you?
Drive safe~ Kids at school say I'm kind of weird. Sounds right. But you're kind of weird too.
But you're kind of weird too. Get lost. Then, since we're both weird, want to be friends? Seriously, get lost... or else. We met again today.
We met again today. Today really was a coincidence. Fine... Can you stop talking to me already? Sorry... I talk a lot. But why don't you go to school?
But why don't you go to school? Huh? That... shit! Babe, that's her. The bitch who hit me last time. Who, that loser bitch? No, no.
No, no. The pink-haired delivery bitch next to her! Was it you? The bitch who messed with my girl? Move, unless you want to die.
Move, unless you want to die. What'd you say? You tiny bitch? Even this crap's becoming a pain. Chapter 3. Jaei & Hana 2
Let's end this fast. I’ve got deliveries to make. Seriously? Tiny little thing, acting tough.
Tiny little thing, acting tough.
Come on, what are you doing?
Come on, what are you doing?
Damn, this bitch is fast. Hey, hold on. I’m tired.
I’m tired. Just... Let me rest a second. You little bitch.
You little bitch. Go on, act tough now!
What, you gonna call the cops?
You fucking bitch! No!!
No!!
Hey! Are you okay?
Hey, are you okay? Yeah... I’m okay. Yeah, that was dangerous...
Yeah, that was dangerous... Why did you jump in like that? I’m sorry. You got dragged into this because of me. Forget it.
Forget it. I was the one who stepped in first. Hey, um... Can I ask you one favor? What is it? Can you tell me your name now?
Can you tell me your name now? That’s what you’re curious about right now?
Jaei~ Here, drink this.
You don’t have to give me a ride. You’re busy.
You’re busy. What if they drag you away again? Thanks to you, they don’t come near me anymore.
Why do you try so hard when you’re not even good at studying? I may not be good at it, but trying hard at something feels good.
Thanks for the ride. Drive safely.
Jaei~~ Hey, Yoon Jaei~~ Hey, Yoon Jaei~~
Hey, Yoon Jaei~~ Chapter 4. Yoon Jaei or CODENAME J
Enjoy your meal. Thank you. Sorry again, little pig...
Hey, what’s wrong? Is something going on?
Is something going on? No. Oh right! Earlier, outside your place, some old man asked me if I knew you.
Earlier, outside your place, some old man asked me if I knew you. Who? Hmm... He had white hair and was wearing a black suit?
He had white hair and was wearing a black suit? Is he someone you know?
Is he someone you know? I don’t know... Jaei, your birthday’s coming up. What should we do for fun?
Not sure... Is there anywhere you want to go? Anything you want to eat?
This girl is the famous Codename J? Yes, that’s correct. So Baeg-Ya’s greatest secret weapon is
So Baeg-Ya’s greatest secret weapon is a young woman like this... Cha Yura secretly adopted her when she was three and raised her. Crazy woman. I guess one miserable life wasn’t enough for her...
I guess one miserable life wasn’t enough for her...
I missed this taste. It’s been a long time,
It’s been a long time, Chairwoman Cha. After ten years away from Korea,
After ten years away from Korea, I didn’t expect to find you eating somewhere this humble. Let’s keep this brief.
Did your reunion with your daughter go well? Thanks to you.
We owe Baeg-Ya quite a debt ourselves. Don’t mention it. We follow the money. The people upstairs are concerned.

The people upstairs are concerned. They are wondering why Baeg-Ya sent you here in person. As you know, I came to see my daughter. Of course. Still, after ten years, we wondered if there was another reason.
Still, after ten years, we wondered if there was another reason. No other reason. I just wanted to see if the country that abandoned me and my daughter was still the same.
me and my daughter was still the same. Then I hope you enjoy your stay. I’ll reassure the people upstairs. I’ll be in touch soon. There’s an important matter we should discuss.
There’s an important matter we should discuss. Please do. Still disgusting bastards.
Still disgusting bastards. Jaei, any birthday plans? Hey, stop leaving me on read.
Hey, stop leaving me on read. Busy? Fine, I’ll decide then...?
Jaei, when is your birthday? I don’t know. Huh?
Huh? Who doesn’t know their own birthday? Hmph... you just don’t want to tell me, do you? I don’t have one.
Oh... Then... how about tomorrow becomes your birthday?
What are you talking about? I don’t need that. Come on~ I’ll celebrate it for you every year. No. Why would you?
Because I’m going to be your friend forever. What are you even saying? Who said I’d be your friend forever? Come on~ let’s just do it that way. Get lost. I said no.
Get lost. I said no.
Keep your promise. Don’t touch Hana. Jaei, why can’t I reach you...?
Jaei, why can’t I reach you...? I’m on my way to your place right now. I’ll call you when I get there...
This number is not in service. Huh?
Jaei! Are you in there?
Jaei! Are you in there? Jaei... Jaei!
Welcome back. Let’s go home now.
Hey, Yoon Jaei...
Hey, Yoon Jaei... Where did you go...? Jaei, who suddenly appeared one day and became my only friend.
Sometimes I wanted to ask who you were and where you came from, but I didn’t. Because I was afraid you might leave me one day.
But one day, My precious friend Jaei disappeared just like that.
